Update on seasonal influenza vaccination
note: The 2026–2027 Northern Hemisphere vaccine is expected in early to mid October, about two weeks later than usual because of delays across the industry. People in recommended groups who have not had a flu jab can get the Southern Hemisphere vaccine now and the new one at least 8 weeks later. People who already had the Southern Hemisphere vaccine should wait for the new one.

label: Update on influenza situation in Singapore
note: Flu cases are rising, but there is no sign that infections are more severe than usual. Flu positivity reached 36.6% in the week of 16–22 August, up from 24.0% the week before and below the January 2025 peak of 43.9%. If you are unwell, stay home. If you must go out, wear a mask and avoid crowded places.
